scope_note.zh: 本表整理阿里云百炼官方公开目录、型号专页和地区价目中明确出现的千问自有托管语言模型准确 ID，覆盖当前商业主线、明确快照/别名、多模态理解、代码、长文档、翻译、深入研究及当前可确认的开源版托管服务。仅有价格或历史上架记录、而当前可用性未明确的条目记为 unknown；有价格不等于仍可调用。地域、部署范围、账户权限和协议支持不同；本表不承诺所有地区均可用，也不穷举所有历史/开源长尾快照、微调或专属部署 ID。排除第三方转售、绘图/视频生成、独立 ASR/TTS、实时语音接口、向量、重排序、纯 OCR 和智能路由服务；Omni 仅按可输出文本的多模态理解语言模型收录。免费试用额度不等于免费型号。资料核对不包含真实 API 调用，不继承其他型号或示例的实测结论，也不改变仓库默认调用型号。
scope_note.en: This list records exact Qwen-owned hosted language-model IDs explicitly present in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's public catalog, model pages, and regional pricing tables. It covers current commercial mainlines, documented snapshots/aliases, multimodal understanding, coding, long-document, translation, deep-research, and currently identifiable hosted open-weight models. An entry supported only by pricing or historical release records is marked unknown when current availability is not established; a price is not proof that an ID remains callable. Regions, deployment scopes, account permissions, and protocol support differ. This is not an all-region inventory or an exhaustive list of historical/open-weight snapshots, fine-tunes, or dedicated-deployment IDs. Third-party resale, image/video generation, standalone ASR/TTS, realtime speech interfaces, embeddings, reranking, OCR-only models, and model routers are excluded. Omni models are included for multimodal understanding with text output. Trial credits do not make a model free. This documentation check sends no API requests, inherits no test result from another model or example, and changes no repository default.
